subject_uz: Yangi Navoiy shaharchasidagi bog' hududiga temir to'siq (metall profil va profnastil) o'rnatish xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: 3000 kv.m yer maydonini metall profil va 3500 kv.m profnastil bilan o'rash xizmati bajariladi.
requirements.summary_en: Fence a 3000 sq.m plot using metal profile and 3500 sq.m of profiled sheet.
requirements.quote: 3000 квадрат метр ер майдонини 3000 квадрат метр метал профилга, 3500 квадрат метр профнастил билан ўраш хизмати

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik topshiriqda to'siq uzunligi 1500 metr va balandligi 3,50 metr ko'rsatilgan.
requirements.summary_en: The technical assignment states a fence length of 1500 m and a height of 3.50 m.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi shartnomani bajarish uchun texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslariga ega bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have the technical, financial, material and staff resources needed to perform the contract.
requirements.quote: Шартномани бажариш учун зарур техник, молиявий, моддий, кадрлар ресурсларининг ҳамда бошқа ресурсларнинг мавжудлиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Mezon 1 (5 ball): tegishli malakali yoki shartnoma asosida jalb etiladigan mutaxassislar mavjudligi baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Criterion 1 (5 points): availability of qualified or contracted specialists is scored.
requirements.quote: Ишларни бажариш ёки хизматларни кўрсатиш учун тегишли зарурий малакали ёки шартнома асосида ёлланадиган мутахассислар мавжудлигига қўйиладиган талаблар

requirements.summary_uz: Mezon 2 (5 ball): ishlarni o'z vaqtida va sifatli bajarish bo'yicha kafolat xati taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Criterion 2 (5 points): a guarantee letter on timely, quality performance is submitted.
requirements.quote: Ишларни ўз вақтида ва сифатли бажариш кафолат хати

requirements.summary_uz: Mezon 3 (5 ball): obyektni ko'rganlik haqida Direksiya va talabgor imzolagan, muhrlangan dalolatnoma talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Criterion 3 (5 points): an act of site inspection signed and sealed by both the Directorate and the bidder is required.
requirements.quote: объектни келиб урганганлиги юзасидан Дирекция ва талабгор уртасида икки томонлама имзоланган ва мухирланган далолатномани

requirements.summary_uz: Mezon 4 (5 ball): sug'urta polislari ilova qilinadi (uchinchi shaxslar oldidagi javobgarlikni sug'urtalash mezoni).
requirements.summary_en: Criterion 4 (5 points): insurance policies are attached (third-party liability insurance criterion).
requirements.quote: Агар ижрочидан шартномани бажариш жараёнида учинчи шахслар олдида жавобгарликни суғурталаш талаб этилса

requirements.summary_uz: Mezon 5 (5 ball): soliq va bank qarzdorligi hamda K-2 kartotekasi bo'yicha ma'lumotnomalar taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Criterion 5 (5 points): certificates of no tax/bank debt and no K-2 card-file entries are submitted.
requirements.quote: Қарздорлик ва картотека К-2 мавжуд эмаслиги маълумотномалари

requirements.summary_uz: Ish qiymatining 30 foizi miqdorida oldindan to'lov beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: An advance payment of 30 percent of the work value is made.
requirements.quote: Tanlash takliflari bo’yicha belgilangan ish qiymatining 30%miqdorida oldindan to’lov

requirements.summary_uz: Boshlang'ich narx 1 100 000 000 so'm, moliyalashtirish byudjet mablag'lari hisobidan.
requirements.summary_en: Start price is 1,100,000,000 UZS, funded from the budget.

requirements.summary_uz: Takliflar qabul qilish tugagach 3 kun ichida baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Bids are evaluated within 3 days after the end of bid acceptance.
requirements.quote: Tanlash takliflarini qabul qilish tugagan kundan boshlab 3 kun davomida

flags.quote: объектни келиб урганганлиги юзасидан Дирекция ва талабгор уртасида икки томонлама имзоланган ва мухирланган далолатномани
flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 3 (5 ball) buyurtmachi (Direksiya) ham imzolaydigan obyekt ko'rigi dalolatnomasini talab qiladi. Texnik qism bo'yicha o'tish bali 25, mezonlarning yig'indisi esa 5 x 5 = 25 ball, ya'ni har bir mezonda to'liq ball kerak bo'lib ko'rinadi; buyurtmachi imzosi bo'lmasa, ishtirokchi o'ta olmasligi mumkin. Takliflar e'londan 7 kun ichida qabul qilinadi, shu muddatda ko'rikdan o'tish va imzo olish barcha uchun ham oson emas.
flags.explanation_en: Criterion 3 (5 points) requires a site-inspection act that the customer's Directorate must also sign. The technical pass mark is 25 and the five criteria add up to 5 x 5 = 25 points, so full marks appear to be needed on every criterion; without the customer's signature a bidder may not pass. Bids are accepted for only 7 days after publication, which makes arranging the visit and signature hard for some bidders.
flags.rewrite_uz: Obyektni ko'rish ixtiyoriy bo'lsin; ko'rik o'tkazilsa, dalolatnoma buyurtmachi tomonidan ariza kelgan kundan boshlab 1 ish kuni ichida rasmiylashtirilsin va uning mavjudligi yoki yo'qligi sababli ishtirokchi texnik bosqichdan chetlashtirilmasin.
flags.rewrite_en: Make the site visit optional; if a visit is held, the customer issues the act within 1 working day of the request, and absence of the act does not remove a bidder from the technical stage.

flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 5 sarlavhasi xodimlarni o'qitish talabiga oid, lekin unga 5 ball soliq va bank qarzdorligi ma'lumotnomalari uchun beriladi. Bu platformaning standart shabloniga o'xshaydi va obyektni to'siq bilan o'rash xizmatiga bevosita aloqador emas; ballar umumiy 25 ballning 20 foizini tashkil qiladi.
flags.explanation_en: The title of Criterion 5 concerns training of the customer's staff, yet its 5 points are awarded for tax and bank debt certificates. This looks like standard platform template wording and is not tied to a fencing service; the points are 20 percent of the 25-point technical total.
flags.rewrite_uz: Mezon 5 ni xizmat predmetiga mos mezon bilan almashtiring (masalan, o'xshash ishlar tajribasi yoki ish bajarish jadvali), qarzdorlik ma'lumotnomalari esa malaka talabi sifatida (o'tdi/o'tmadi) qoldirilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Replace Criterion 5 with one tied to the service (for example experience with similar works or a work schedule) and keep the debt certificates as a pass/fail qualification requirement.

flags.rewrite_uz: Texnik topshiriqqa to'siqning aniq uzunligi, balandligi va materiallar bo'yicha yagona hajm jadvalini kiriting.
flags.rewrite_en: Add a single quantity table with the exact fence length, height and quantity per material to the technical assignment.

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 3 (5 ball) buyurtmachi (Direksiya) ham imzolaydigan obyekt ko'rigi dalolatnomasini talab qiladi. Texnik qism bo'yicha o'tish bali 25, mezonlarning yig'indisi esa 5 x 5 = 25 ball, ya'ni har bir mezonda to'liq ball kerak bo'lib ko'rinadi; buyurtmachi imzosi bo'lmasa, ishtirokchi o'ta olmasligi mumkin. Takliflar e'londan 7 kun ichida qabul qilinadi, shu muddatda ko'rikdan o'tish va imzo olish barcha uchun ham oson emas.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 5 sarlavhasi xodimlarni o'qitish talabiga oid, lekin unga 5 ball soliq va bank qarzdorligi ma'lumotnomalari uchun beriladi. Bu platformaning standart shabloniga o'xshaydi va obyektni to'siq bilan o'rash xizmatiga bevosita aloqador emas; ballar umumiy 25 ballning 20 foizini tashkil qiladi.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (1-bet): Hajm raqamlari bir-biriga mos kelmaydi: 3000 kv.m yer, 3000 kv.m metall profil va 3500 kv.m profnastil ko'rsatilgan, 1500 m uzunlik va 3,50 m balandlik esa taxminan 5250 kv.m to'siqni bildiradi. Aniq hajm noma'lum bo'lsa, ishtirokchilar narxni bir xil asosda hisoblay olmaydi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): Criterion 3 (5 points) requires a site-inspection act that the customer's Directorate must also sign. The technical pass mark is 25 and the five criteria add up to 5 x 5 = 25 points, so full marks appear to be needed on every criterion; without the customer's signature a bidder may not pass. Bids are accepted for only 7 days after publication, which makes arranging the visit and signature hard for some bidders.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): The title of Criterion 5 concerns training of the customer's staff, yet its 5 points are awarded for tax and bank debt certificates. This looks like standard platform template wording and is not tied to a fencing service; the points are 20 percent of the 25-point technical total.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 1): The quantities do not agree: 3000 sq.m of land, 3000 sq.m of metal profile and 3500 sq.m of profiled sheet are listed, while 1500 m length at 3.50 m height implies about 5250 sq.m of fence. If the real quantity is unclear, bidders cannot price on the same basis.
